# Legacy golden fixtures — provenance

Frozen old-release shapes for `tests/test_upgrade_golden_fixtures.py`.
Each entry names the era it froze, the in-repo evidence it came from, and
whether the shape is **recorded** (taken from evidence in this repository)
or **inferred** (assembled by the test author from documented behavior;
never presented as a recorded shape).

| Fixture | Era | Provenance |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `job_pre_starter_stamp.json` | JOB.json as written before #1029 (starter mentions), i.e. the 2.2.x shape | **Recorded.** Field set mirrors the job dict the pre-#1029 test suite built (`tests/hermes/test_print_messages.py` at commit `752bee5^`: title, gcode, derived_plates, color_manifest, color_decisions) and the replay harness's minimal job (`tests/replay/helpers.py::make_job`). The defining facts are the absences: no `started_by` stamp (#1029 added it; pre-existing jobs are documented to behave as before) and no `printer_id` / project fields. G-code paths are bare file names; the test materializes real files under those names. |
| `hardware_ifs_slots.json` | Per-printer hardware record before the #672 key rename | **Recorded.** The `ifs_slots` slot map is the pre-rename spelling pinned by `tests/test_renamed_key_readers.py` and by `tests/test_per_printer_state.py::test_hardware_record_written_with_the_old_slots_key_is_adopted` (record `{"spool": {}, "ifs_slots": {"1": {"spoolman_id": 7}}}`); the surrounding spool / temps_c / nozzle sections are the sections `print_handy.doctor.check_hardware` requires. Slot contents beyond the spool id are representative. |
| `print_record_pre_record_id.json` | Print record from the JSON-records era (#392) before per-launch numbering (#979/#988) | **Mixed.** The absence of `record_id` is **recorded**: `print_handy.core.print_stats.record_key` documents that records without one fall back to number + start time because pre-#979/#988 reprints were recorded under the original's number. The field subset is the 2.2.x writer's field list (`print_records._RECORD_FIELDS` at tag `2.2.0`, minus the project / starter fields added later) — that subset selection is **inferred** as representative, not a byte-for-byte captured file. |
| `print_record_obsidian_note.md` | Print record before #392, when records were Obsidian Markdown notes | **Mixed.** The format (a Markdown note, replaced by one JSON file per print in #392) is **recorded** in commit `25f77ac`'s message. The note's exact wording is **inferred** — no real note survives in this repository. The test only asserts the JSON loader's behavior toward it (it is not a `print-*.json` file, so it is neither loaded nor listed as skipped), never its content. |
| `settings_all_retired_keys.toml` | A local settings file carrying every retired/renamed key at once | **Recorded.** Keys: `printer.ifs_slots` and `webui.secure_cookie` (the two `settings.KEY_ALIASES` entries from #672, pinned by `tests/test_renamed_key_readers.py` and `tests/test_settings.py`), plus `services.openviking_url` (retired configuration dropped on load, pinned by `tests/test_retired_memory_config.py`). Values follow the loadable shapes in `tests/test_settings.py` (`ifs_slots = 3` in a bare `[printer]` file). `printer.family` is deliberately NOT in this file: it is not an alias — the loader rejects it with a named replacement hint (`settings._unknown`), and the test asserts that separately. |
